description.value: Match Eatery & Public House is a casual dining pub chain affiliated with Gateway Casinos, with the Delta location situated along Highway 17A. It offers a full dine-in menu spanning burgers, pasta, pizza, and wings alongside an extensive drinks program, plus takeout and delivery. Touring cyclists passing through the Delta/Tsawwassen corridor will find a reliable full-service stop with hot meals and a broad menu.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at matchpub.com/delta confirms this is an active Match Eatery & Public House located at 6005 Highway 17A, Delta, BC V4K 0B2, with phone (604) 921-3201 — neither of which appear in OSM tags. Takeout and delivery are explicitly listed in the site navigation. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere on the website; OSM tags note free Wi-Fi (internet_access=wlan, internet_access:fee=no) but this is not confirmed by the website content.
concerns: OSM community field is 'Richmond' but the confirmed business address is in Delta, BC — likely a community assignment error in the OSM data.
OSM tags contain no address or phone number; both were sourced from the website.
OSM tags note free Wi-Fi (internet_access=wlan, internet_access:fee=no) but this is not confirmed or mentioned anywhere in the website content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible restaurant and pub with confirmed address and contact details. A useful full-service food and drink stop for touring cyclists on the Highway 17A corridor.
